version: Agent Runtime (renamed 2026-04-22); Agent Identity GA claim on 2026-04-22, API in Preview per 2026-06-18 note

facts.claim: Semantic governance policies support VPC Service Controls (Preview) (2026-09-25).
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Admins can write IAM allow/deny policies naming an agent's principal; agent identity defaults include roles/aiplatform.agentDefaultAccess and agentContextEditor.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D01.rationale: Approval/HITL is delegated to the agent framework (ADK etc.); the platform provides IAM allow/deny for agent identities and (Preview) semantic governance policies; no platform-level per-tool approval default.

facts.claim: Computer Use and Shell sandboxes are generally available (2026-09-09); sandboxes gain VPC Service Controls, private service connectivity, CMEK and pause/resume.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D02.rationale: Agent Sandbox (computer use and shell sandboxes GA 2026-09-09) with VPC-SC, PSC, CMEK and pause/resume; agent code itself runs in a managed runtime (bring-your-own-container supported).

facts.claim: Agent Gateway now enforces VPC Service Controls perimeter rules for agent communications (2026-09-09); applies to gateways created after 2026-09-08 using the agent connectivity template.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Access doc states 'VPC Service Controls isn't supported with Agent Gateway' while the 2026-09-09 release note says the gateway enforces VPC-SC rules; the docs are mutually inconsistent or version-dependent.
facts.label: unverified

D03.rationale: Agent Gateway enforces VPC-SC perimeter rules (gateways created after 2026-09-08, requires ALL_TRAFFIC egress mode); Model Armor for Agent Gateway GA. VPC-SC not supported with Agent Gateway per access doc (conflicting notes).

facts.claim: Agent Gateway, Agent Observability and Agent Registry are GA (2026-06-18); Model Armor for Agent Gateway GA (2026-06-24).
facts.label: from-official-docs

D05.rationale: Agent Gateway, Agent Registry (GA 2026-06-18) and Model Armor on the gateway provide central tool governance and prompt/response screening.

facts.claim: Unit 42 (2026-03-31): default P4SA service agent for Agent Engine/ADK deployments had excessive default permissions; credentials retrievable from metadata service gave read access to project Cloud Storage buckets and Google-owned Artifact Registry images.
facts.label: third-party-report

facts.claim: Unit 42: Google updated docs and the ADK deployment workflow; recommended BYOSA and least-privilege OAuth scopes; default scopes are broad and cannot be edited.
facts.label: third-party-report

facts.claim: Agents run under either Agent Identity (preview) or a service account (Reasoning Engine Service Agent or custom); 'Deployed agents have access to all resources that their service account has permission to access'; service agent is hidden in the console by default.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Agent Identity API replaces the legacy IAM Connectors API (2026-06-18) and is in Preview.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D07.rationale: Default service-agent identity (P4SA / Reasoning Engine Service Agent) historically carried excessive permissions and non-editable broad OAuth scopes; Agent Identity (SPIFFE, no key material) is the recommended alternative but its API is still Preview; Secret Manager recommended for API keys.

facts.claim: Memory Bank and Sessions global and multi-regional endpoints GA (2026-06-17); IngestEvents GA (2026-07-08); memory profiles GA (2026-07-15).
facts.label: from-official-docs

D09.rationale: Memory Bank (renamed Agent Platform Memory Bank) GA with multi-regional endpoints, IngestEvents and memory profiles GA (Jun-Jul 2026); scoping/poisoning controls not verified.

D11.rationale: Agent Observability GA (2026-06-18); Cloud Audit Logs applies as for other Google Cloud services (not separately verified).

D12.rationale: Not verified (Google Cloud data governance terms not read).

D13.rationale: N/A (managed; Python SDK google-cloud-aiplatform on PyPI).

facts.claim: A role can be granted to all Agent Runtime agents in a project or organization using a principalSet.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D14.rationale: Enterprise controls via IAM (allow/deny, principalSet for all Agent Runtime agents in a project/org), VPC Service Controls, CMEK, Model Armor; organisation-wide semantic policies in Preview.

facts.claim: GHSA-qv8j-hgpc-vrq8 / CVE-2026-2472 (stored XSS in Vertex AI SDK, >=1.98.0 <1.131.0) and GHSA-wh2j-26j7-9728 / CVE-2026-2473 (predictable bucket naming, >=1.21.0 <1.133.0), published 2026-02-20.
facts.label: from-official-docs
facts.relabelled: A09: source/API read, not a local test

D15.rationale: Google issued GHSA/CVEs for the Vertex AI Python SDK (CVE-2026-2472 stored XSS, CVE-2026-2473 predictable bucket naming); Agent Engine design weakness handled via documentation changes rather than CVE.
